LOOK: Pro-Duterte group Hakbang ng Maisug held their 7th day of protest in front of Supreme Court in Manila, urging the high court to halt the impeachment hearings against Vice President Sara Duterte.

They are also calling for the release of former President Rodrigo Duterte from ICC detention facility at The Hague. | via @chedcgatchalian, https://t.co/9R0Mcay5im
